question: In which month is the Kaliyattam festival celebrated?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Kumbham (February-March)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Kaliyattam festival is primarily dedicated to the worship of Goddess Kali.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The Kaliyattam festival is primarily dedicated to the **worship of Goddess Kali**.

 
 
• 
 
It is celebrated in the Malayalam month of **Kumbham** (February-March).

 
 
• 
 
The festival is celebrated in **Kavus (sacred groves)** and **Tharavadus (ancestral households)**.

 
 
• 
 
Performers of Kaliyattam are believed to become **channels of deities**, making the performances a **"dance of gods"** or **"dance of the divine"**.

 
 
• 
 
Kaliyattam is considered an important part of **Kerala’s intangible heritage**.

 
 
• 
 
The festival is also known by the name **Theyyam**.
